text:
jess: Quick intake — ran Mercury11B int4 smoke on the longform summarization slice (~1.2k avg tokens). Cost looks great (~3.7x savings vs fp16) but we see a small quality hit on the referentiality metric (↓4.2 pts). Sharing quick notes and next steps.

kai: Nice, can you paste the perf numbers (p95, p99, tok/s) and the eval config?

jess: p95 420ms (fp16 400ms), p99 890ms. throughput ~210 tok/s. unit cost per 1k tokens: $0.035 int4 vs $0.13 fp16. Eval: `eval/run_longform.py --seed 42 --metrics referentiality,rouge --slices citations,coref,dialogue`.

priya: The referentiality drop — is it concentrated on citation-heavy prompts or on coref chains?

jess: Mostly citation-heavy paragraphs and multi-entity coref. Quick example (redacted):
jess: gold: "According to Smith (2020), the algorithm converges in O(n) time."
jess: int4: "Smith (2020) suggests convergence, but details are unclear."

sam: Looks like hallucination of attribution. Can we try stronger priming / retrieval + short context to see if quality recovers?

kai: Also pls add baseline comparison to our 13B-int6 hybrid route — GTN/product will want cost delta vs that, not just fp16.

jess: Agreed. Next run will include `nova13b-int6` in the matrix. Plan: 10k eval examples, split by slice (citations, coref, dialogue, code-switch). ETA EOD tomorrow for results.

deploy-bot: scheduled_canary: dedicated canary window reserved: 2024-06-12 02:00 UTC pending sign-off.

priya: For the scorecard we should capture: delta referentiality (per-slice), delta rouge, unit cost, p95/p99, top failure modes (examples), and a recommended rollback gate. Product needs explicit thresholds.

jess: Drafting scorecard now, will post link when ready: https://redwood.console/evals/mercury11b-int4-smoke

kai: +1 on rollback thresholds. Proposal: block rollout if referentiality drop >3 pts on citation slice OR if p99 latency regresses >20% for high-context queries.

priya: tagging product for GTN guidance — @marta can you weigh in on acceptable cost/quality tradeoffs for user-facing summarization?

marta: product: cost win is compelling but citation regressions reduce trust. If we can mitigate via priming+retrieval or run int4 behind an internal-beta flag (limited traffic + monitoring), i'm OK to pilot. Need clear alerting on referentiality and sample review cadence.

jess: Thanks — will run priming trials, add nova13b-int6 to compare, and post updated scorecard + sampled failures. Will also include a small AB with caching on/off to quantify impact.

kai: Please include eval seed/randomization and exact commit hash for model/quant kernels in the scorecard so ops can reproduce.

jess: will do (commit: a1b2c3d).

marta: thx — product will review scorecard after the extended smoke tomorrow.

priya: small ask for ops: can someone pre-approve a rollback playbook? i.e., immediate traffic shift to nova13b-int6 or fp16 fallback.

sam: I can draft the rollback doc; will post as a short runbook in #eng-oncall.

jess: awesome, thanks everyone. I'll update here when the priming + nova13b runs finish.
